_demo_note: Meter-level field demo: IMU axes from user (front=-Y,left=+X,up=+Z) and photo; heading anchored by magnetic at start then corrected by measured RTK travel direction; antenna offset, footprint radius, declination and absolute heading accuracy are NOT measured; arrival tolerance 3 m is a software criterion, not a geographic accuracy claim. Correction-age limit raised to 30 s for the field demo: the caster corrections were measured fresh (GPS epoch 0.3-0.7 s at arrival) while the receiver-reported GGA age repeatedly climbs to ~9 s; this remains a quality gate, not an accuracy claim.
_mock_note: Indoor mock mode: NAV-PVT/GGA produced by deploy/lynx/mock_virtual_base.py in the real receiver format; command outputs remapped to /mock_base/cmd_vel and integrated by a virtual base. No real /cmd_vel publisher and no chassis bridge in this mode. scan_range_min_m=1.2 ignores the front lidar self/leg returns below 1.2 m that otherwise block every DWB trajectory. obstacle_layer disabled in mock mode: indoor surroundings are not the mapped scene; the outdoor profile keeps it enabled.
